json_schema.description: The parts of a data contract that need judgement: what a row is, and why.

column_notes.description: Optional one-line descriptions of non-obvious output columns, by name.
column_notes.title: Column Notes

grain.description: What one row of the output represents, in one sentence.
grain.title: Grain

keys.description: The output's business key: the smallest set of columns that identifies a row. Choose from the candidate keys listed in the prompt.
keys.title: Keys

partition_columns.description: At most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by, e.g. lob_code; may be empty.
partition_columns.title: Partition Columns

json_schema.title: ContractAnswer

request.system_prompt: You are the contract agent of LANSH, a factory that migrates legacy jobs to PySpark and proves every output matches the legacy output record for record. For one output table, say what one row represents (the grain), choose its business key from the candidate keys you are given (prefer a meaningful business key to a generated one), and name at most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by. Comparison policies are not yours to choose.

column_notes.expense_amt: Sum of EXPENSE-type amounts; NULL in the same cases as indemnity_amt.
column_notes.first_payment_date: payment_date of the claim's first payment in keyed order (_row_seq), not necessarily the earliest date.
column_notes.gross_paid: indemnity_amt + expense_amt; NULL if either one is NULL.
column_notes.has_payment: 1 if the claim has at least one payment on or before as_of, otherwise 0.
column_notes.indemnity_amt: Sum of INDEMNITY-type amounts (type matched ignoring case). NULL if the claim has no payments, or if any payment amount was missing, because '+' carries missing values through.
column_notes.last_payment_date: payment_date of the claim's last payment in keyed order (_row_seq), not necessarily the latest date.
column_notes.lob_code: Line of business, upper-cased and stripped.
column_notes.n_payments: Number of payment rows dated on or before as_of; 0 if the claim has no payments.
column_notes.n_recoveries: Number of payment rows with a negative amount (recoveries); 0 if no payments.
column_notes.net_paid: SAS sum() of indemnity, expense and recovery, which skips missing values; NULL only when all three are NULL.
column_notes.recovery_amt: Sum of RECOVERY-type amounts; NULL if the claim has no payments.
column_notes.recovery_flag: 1 if any payment amount is negative, otherwise 0.
column_notes.total_paid: Sum of all payment amounts to as_of, recoveries included; 0 if no payments.

structured_output.grain: One row per claim on the claims register (stg.claims), with its payment history rolled up to the reporting date (as_of); claims with no payments yet are kept too.
